understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level while progressing efficiently until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is horizontal via MOVE_LEFT or MOVE_RIGHT, after which gravity automatically carries the player until landing, hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. Spike tiles are fatal, while support tiles are safe. CLICK targets and removes clickable breakable blocks to open paths, and UNDO reverses the previous action. Each level allows two attempts with up to 50 turns per attempt; corridor and landing previews help identify safe passage columns and changes in height.
